versions.changelog:
newton-quotation-pdf-extraction v0.1.0

- Initial release for extracting structured product info (model, quantity, price, currency, image) from PDF quotations and catalogs.
- Emphasizes pre-analysis of PDF text structure before coding extraction logic.
- Handles multiple products per line and varying price/unit layouts.
- Provides Python code templates for PDF structure analysis and product info extraction, including edge cases (cross-line data, mixed model notations).
- Enforces dynamic extraction from PDF only; no hardcoding or currency guessing.
